description.text: 1. Objectives It is to cultivate experts in fields like Animation, Digital movies, production and directing, Acting and hosting study. Students are expected to master basic theories systematically and professional skills in this field, and to familiarize themselves with historical research data and current research both at home and abroad. They will also possess strong creating, researching and teaching ability. 2. Academic Years set for this major Altogether 3 years set for postgraduate. 3. Research directions 1) Animation 2) Digital movies, production and directing 3) Acting and hosting study 4. Thesis 1.Students can apply to choose graduation designing and thesis research after they have got all the credits required. Thesis writing is crucial in training students' research methods and ability to do research independently. 2.Students should hand in 2 or 3 related comprehensive reports before choosing thesis topic. 3.Graduation designing and thesis-topic selection are arranged in the 2nd semester of the 2nd academic year. Students should choose an appropriate topic according to their interest, their ability as well as significant theoretical and technical issues in Art Designing both home and abroad. 4.The thesis topic selection report should include over 2000 words. It should consist such parts as analysis of current situation, objective and significance, time arrangement for both research and designing. 5. Graduation designing and thesis topic selection report should be presented to Postgraduate Department for record after expert examination＆approval organized by Teaching Research Office. 6.Graduation designing should be done independently under the supervision of mentors. After being approved by three teachers with senior title, this college will organize thesis debate by inviting professionals from both this college and other colleges. And all the graduation designing works will be public exhibited.

duration.text: The Radio and Television Art Science at Shanghai University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. Certificate of English proficiency test IELTS or TOEFl will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker. 7. Certificate of Chinese language education For applying Chinese-medium programs. 8. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. (at least 1 A4 page)

requirements.text: 1. Undergraduate graduation, hold a Bachelor's Degree 2. HSK 6 3. Aged 18 - 40
